title: Thai Pork Curry
description: A classic Thai dish with tender pork in a flavorful and aromatic curry sauce. Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, and sugar. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until the pork is tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the Thai basil. Season with salt to taste.
Serve the curry over steamed rice or noodles.
